text.2:200: And when ye have completed your devotions, then remember Allah as ye remember your fathers or with a more lively remembrance. But of mankind is he who saith: "Our Lord! Give unto us in the world," and he hath no portion in the Hereafter.
text.3:58: This (which) We recite unto thee is a revelation and a wise reminder.
text.5:91: Satan seeketh only to cast among you enmity and hatred by means of strong drink and games of chance, and to turn you from remembrance of Allah and from (His) worship. Will ye then have done?
text.7:63: Marvel ye that there should come unto you a Reminder from your Lord by means of a man among you, that he may warn you, and that ye may keep from evil, and that haply ye may find mercy.
text.7:69: Marvel ye that there should come unto you a Reminder from your Lord by means of a man among you, that he may warn you? Remember how He made you viceroys after Noah's folk, and gave you growth of stature. Remember (all) the bounties of your Lord, that haply ye may be successful.
text.12:42: And he said unto him of the twain who he knew would be released: Mention me in the presence of thy lord. But Satan caused him to forget to mention it to his lord, so he (Joseph) stayed in prison for some years.
text.12:104: Thou askest them no fee for it. It is naught else than a reminder unto the peoples.
text.13:28: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!
text.15:6: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!
text.15:9: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.
text.16:43: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men whom We inspired - Ask the followers of the Remembrance if ye know not! -
text.16:44: With clear proofs and writings; and We have revealed unto thee the Remembrance that thou mayst explain to mankind that which hath been revealed for them, and that haply they may reflect.
text.18:28: Restrain thyself along with those who cry unto their Lord at morn and evening, seeking His Countenance; and let not thine eyes overlook them, desiring the pomp of the life of the world; and obey not him whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, who followeth his own lust and whose case hath been abandoned.
text.18:70: He said: Well, if thou go with me, ask me not concerning aught till I myself make mention of it unto thee.
text.18:83: They will ask thee of Dhu'l-Qarneyn. Say: I shall recite unto you a remembrance of him.
text.18:101: Those whose eyes were hoodwinked from My reminder, and who could not bear to hear.
text.19:2: A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah.
text.20:14: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance.
text.20:42: Go, thou and thy brother, with My tokens, and be not faint in remembrance of Me.
text.20:99: Thus relate We unto thee (Muhammad) some tidings of that which happened of old, and We have given thee from Our presence a reminder.
text.20:113: Thus we have revealed it as a Lecture in Arabic, and have displayed therein certain threats, that peradventure they may keep from evil or that it may cause them to take heed.
text.20:124: But he who turneth away from remembrance of Me, his will be a narrow life, and I shall bring him blind to the assembly on the Day of Resurrection.
text.21:2: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play,
text.21:7: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not?
text.21:10: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense?
text.21:24: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse.
text.21:36: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent.
text.21:42: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!
text.21:48: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,
text.21:50: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?
text.21:105: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth:
text.23:71: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.
text.23:110: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.
text.24:37: Men whom neither merchandise nor sale beguileth from remembrance of Allah and constancy in prayer and paying to the poor their due; who fear a day when hearts and eyeballs will be overturned;
text.25:18: They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk.
text.25:29: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need.
text.26:5: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.
text.29:45: Recite that which hath been inspired in thee of the Scripture, and establish worship. Lo! worship preserveth from lewdness and iniquity, but verily remembrance of Allah is more important. And Allah knoweth what ye do.
text.33:41: O ye who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance.
text.36:11: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward.
text.36:69: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
text.37:3: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
text.37:168: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
text.38:8: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.
text.38:32: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.
text.38:49: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end,
text.38:87: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples
text.39:22: Is he whose bosom Allah hath expanded for Al-Islam, so that he followeth a light from his Lord, (as he who disbelieveth)? Then woe unto those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah. Such are in plain error.
text.39:23: Allah hath (now) revealed the fairest of statements, a Scripture consistent, (wherein promises of reward are) paired (with threats of punishment), whereat doth creep the flesh of those who fear their Lord, so that their flesh and their hearts soften to Allah's reminder. Such is Allah's guidance, wherewith He guideth whom He will. And him whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.
text.41:41: Lo! those who disbelieve in the Reminder when it cometh unto them (are guilty), for lo! it is an unassailable Scripture.
text.43:5: Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk?
text.43:36: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;
text.43:44: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.
text.53:29: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
text.54:17: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
text.54:22: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
text.54:25: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
text.54:32: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
text.54:40: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
text.57:16: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers.
text.58:19: The devil hath engrossed them and so hath caused them to forget remembrance of Allah. They are the devil's party. Lo! is it not the devil's party who will be the losers?
text.62:9: O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better for you if ye did but know.
text.63:9: O ye who believe! Let not your wealth nor your children distract you from remembrance of Allah. Those who do so, they are the losers.
text.65:10: Allah hath prepared for them stern punishment; so keep your duty to Allah, O men of understanding! O ye who believe! Now Allah hath sent down unto you a reminder,
text.68:51: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;
text.68:52: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.
text.72:17: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
text.77:5: By those who bring down the Reminder,
text.81:27: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
